title: Te Wairua Manawanui o te Whare Tapu
intro: I roto i ngā whārangi o te Quran, ka puta mai tētahi tangata i te whakapapa o tētahi poropiti nui, i tukuna hei koha i te kaumātuatanga. E whakanuia ana tēnei wairua mō tōna pono pumau me tana mahi nui ki te whakatū i tētahi wāhi tapu hei tohu mō te whakapono. I a koe e pānui ana i ngā tohu, whakarongo pai ki te reo o mua, nā te mea e kōrero ana i te tangata tuatahi.
clues: Kua whakahuatia ahau i roto i te Quran me tētahi atu poropiti hei koha i tukuna ki tētahi karere kaumātua.
Ko ahau tētahi o ngā uri e rua i tukua ki taua poropiti i ōna tau whakamutunga.
E whakanuia ana ahau i roto i te Quran mō te pono ki taku kupu.
I mau ahau i te honore o te poropititanga, ā, i tonoa mai ahau hei karere.
I uru atu ahau ki tōku matua ki te whakaara i ngā turanga o te Whare Tapu.
E maumaharatia ana ahau hei tētahi o te hunga manawanui, ā, ko te whare tapu i hanga e mātou i riro hei wāhi hoki, hei wāhi haumaru hoki mō te tangata.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
